title: Forecourt: the blocks north of the court
caption: The top left of the day's first outdoor frames was a plain box on bare lawn. Head office's wing is now a building with a glazed ground floor and its own doors, a street runs north up the platform shed, and a second street runs behind the wing and the tower. Backdrop only (issue #140). Same cameras before and after.

sections.title: Stepping out of the station (desktop)
sections.caption: Top left: the street leaving the court's north-west corner, the wing with its lawn and hedge, and its staff door's porch.

sections.title: Crossing the court (desktop)
sections.caption: A few steps up the street, three bollards with yellow-and-black chains close it.

sections.title: Stepping out of the station (phone)
sections.caption: The phone looks up the court, so it sees the tower's wall along the service yard; that wall now has windows and a vent.

sections.title: At the chains
sections.caption: Eric can walk up the street as far as the chains.

sections.title: After work
sections.caption: The wing's ground floor and some of its windows are lit, with the windows in the tower's yard wall.

sections.title: From above
sections.caption: The island map's view of the forecourt. After: the street up the shed, the square junction, the cross street behind the wing and the tower, the wing's paths to its door and its bike shelter.
